metadata.name: satpad_vault
metadata.description: Satpad fee vault: splits every coin's pump.fun creator fee (in wBTC) on chain

instructions.name: declare_coin
docs: Registers a pump.fun coin whose creator is this program's `CoinFee` PDA. Signed by the launcher and the new
mint keypair, so only the launch transaction can write the payee choice, once. Collects the launch fee.

accounts.name: user
docs: The launcher. Pays rent and the launch fee.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The new coin's mint keypair. Signing proves this runs in the launch transaction.

accounts.name: coin
docs: `init` makes a second declaration fail.

accounts.name: coin_fee_ata
docs: `ATA(coin_fee, quote_mint)`: where pump.fun's permissionless collect pays the creator fee (VERIFIED V4).
Created here because neither pump program creates it.

instructions.name: draw_lp
docs: LP wallet draws up to `Config.lp_draw_max` from `LpPot`, at least `Config.lp_draw_interval` after the last draw.
The only instruction that moves BTC out of `LpPot`.

accounts.name: lp_wallet
docs: Only `Config.lp_wallet`.

accounts.name: lp_ata
docs: `ATA(Config.lp_wallet, quote)` — the only possible destination.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Creates `Config` and `LpPot`. Once.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Deployer; pays rent. Runs once because `config` is `init`.

accounts.name: quote_mint
docs: The BTC quote mint. Decimals are read from here, never assumed.

accounts.name: lp_pot
docs: `["lp_pot"]`: token account holding the liquidity share from every coin. Authority is `config`; only
`draw_lp` can move it out.

instructions.name: pay_payee
docs: Transfers the whole `PayeePot` to the current payee's quote ATA. Anyone can call; never creates the ATA.

accounts.name: coin
docs: Checked before `payee_ata` so a Holders-mode coin fails with `HoldersMode`, not an ATA mismatch.

accounts.name: payee_ata
docs: `ATA(coin.payee, quote)`. Must already exist: the vault never pays rent for a payee's ATA (SPEC "Payouts").

instructions.name: recover
docs: Only while a coin is paused: moves its `CoinFee` balance to the fixed `RECOVERY_ADDRESS`.

accounts.name: recovery_ata
docs: `ATA(RECOVERY_ADDRESS, quote)` — the only possible destination. The admin creates it beforehand.

instructions.name: redirect_payee
docs: Current payee hands the deployer share to `new_payee`, receiving whatever is waiting first. Irreversible.

accounts.name: payee
docs: The current payee. Nobody else — not the deployer, not the admin — can call this.

accounts.name: payee_ata
docs: The old payee's quote ATA, paid in the same instruction so a change can never be blocked by a withheld payout.

instructions.name: release_rewards
docs: Rewards wallet moves a Holders-mode coin's `RewardsPot` out for one run, after writing the snapshot hash.
At most once per `REWARDS_RUN_MIN_INTERVAL` per coin.

accounts.name: rewards_wallet
docs: Only `Config.rewards_wallet`. Pays rent for the `RewardsRun` record.

accounts.name: rewards_run
docs: Written before the pot moves; `init` with `run_index = coin.rewards_run_count` makes each run unique.

accounts.name: rewards_ata
docs: `ATA(Config.rewards_wallet, quote)` — the only possible destination.

instructions.name: set_coin_pause
docs: Pauses or unpauses one coin's `settle`.

instructions.name: set_holder_rewards
docs: Current payee makes the deployer share pay holders forever, receiving whatever is waiting first.

accounts.name: payee
docs: The current payee. Nobody else — not the deployer, not the admin — can call this.

accounts.name: payee_ata
docs: The old payee's quote ATA, paid in the same instruction so a change can never be blocked by a withheld payout.

instructions.name: set_lp
docs: Sets the LP wallet and draw limits within the program caps.

instructions.name: set_pause
docs: Pauses or unpauses every coin's `settle`.

instructions.name: set_satpad
docs: Records the $SATPAD mint, its PumpSwap pool and LP mint once bootstrapped (DECISIONS D21). Admin-only and
write-once: refuses when any of the three is already set; changing them afterwards requires an upgrade.

instructions.name: set_split
docs: Changes the split within the program bounds. Applies to every later `settle`.

instructions.name: set_wallets
docs: Changes treasury, buyback and rewards wallets. Never the recovery address (a constant) or the LP wallet.

instructions.name: settle
docs: Splits whatever sits in the coin's `CoinFee` ATA by the current `Config.split`. Anyone can call.

accounts.name: coin_fee_ata
docs: Where pump.fun's collect paid the creator fee.

accounts.name: buyback_ata
docs: `ATA(Config.buyback_wallet, quote)`. Must already exist; the vault never pays rent for a wallet's ATA.

accounts.name: treasury_ata
docs: `ATA(Config.treasury, quote)`.

errors.name: SplitSum
errors.msg: split shares must sum to 10000 bps

errors.name: LiquidityTooLow
errors.msg: liquidity share below the program minimum

errors.name: OperatorTooHigh
errors.msg: operator share above the program maximum

errors.name: CreatorFeeOutOfRange
errors.msg: creator fee bps must be in 1..=MAX_CREATOR_FEE_BPS

errors.name: LpDrawMaxTooHigh
errors.msg: lp_draw_max above the program cap

errors.name: LpDrawIntervalTooShort
errors.msg: lp_draw_interval below the program minimum

errors.name: Overflow
errors.msg: arithmetic overflow

errors.name: WrongQuoteMint
errors.msg: wrong quote mint

errors.name: BadCurveData
errors.msg: bonding curve account data is not a pump.fun BondingCurve

errors.name: WrongCurveCreator
errors.msg: bonding curve creator is not this coin's CoinFee PDA

errors.name: WrongCurveQuoteMint
errors.msg: bonding curve quote mint is not the configured BTC quote mint

errors.name: CreatorFeeMismatch
errors.msg: bonding curve creator_fee_bps does not equal Config.creator_fee_bps

errors.name: HolderRewardCurve
errors.msg: holder-reward curves cannot be registered: pump.fun owns their creator

errors.name: MayhemCurve
errors.msg: mayhem-mode curves cannot be registered

errors.name: NotAdmin
errors.msg: signer is not the admin

errors.name: WrongTreasury
errors.msg: treasury account does not match Config.treasury

errors.name: Paused
errors.msg: vault is paused

errors.name: CoinPaused
errors.msg: coin is paused

errors.name: NotPayee
errors.msg: signer is not the coin's current payee

errors.name: HoldersMode
errors.msg: coin is in holder-rewards mode; nobody controls the deployer share

errors.name: InvalidPayee
errors.msg: new payee must be a real, different wallet

errors.name: NotRewardsWallet
errors.msg: signer is not Config.rewards_wallet

errors.name: NotLpWallet
errors.msg: signer is not Config.lp_wallet

errors.name: RewardsPotBelowMin
errors.msg: rewards pot below the minimum release amount

errors.name: RewardsTooSoon
errors.msg: last rewards run is less than REWARDS_RUN_MIN_INTERVAL seconds old

errors.name: NotHoldersMode
errors.msg: coin is not in holder-rewards mode

errors.name: LpDrawTooLarge
errors.msg: draw exceeds Config.lp_draw_max

errors.name: LpDrawTooSoon
errors.msg: last LP draw is less than Config.lp_draw_interval seconds old

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: signer is not the program's upgrade authority

errors.name: CoinNotPaused
errors.msg: recover requires the coin to be paused

errors.name: WrongRecoveryDestination
errors.msg: recovery destination must be the ATA of the fixed RECOVERY_ADDRESS

errors.name: InvalidWallet
errors.msg: wallet must not be the default pubkey

errors.name: SatpadAlreadySet
errors.msg: $SATPAD mint/pool/LP mint already set; changing them requires a program upgrade (D21)

types.name: Coin
docs: `["coin", mint]`.

fields.name: payee
docs: Current payee when `payee_mode == Wallet`; ignored for `Holders`.

fields.name: treasury_only
docs: $SATPAD only: 100% of the creator fee to treasury. Admin-set at declaration, never changed.

types.name: Config
docs: Singleton `["config"]`. SPEC "Accounts (PDAs)" plus `creator_fee_bps` (D3) and the $SATPAD pool addresses.

fields.name: admin
docs: Hot key: pause, split, wallet changes. Cannot upgrade, cannot set LP params, cannot touch payees.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Operator share and launch fees.

fields.name: buyback_wallet
docs: Buyback share; keeper swaps it for $SATPAD and burns.

fields.name: rewards_wallet
docs: Only destination of `release_rewards`.

fields.name: lp_wallet
docs: Only signer of `draw_lp`. Set by the upgrade authority via `set_lp`.

fields.name: quote_mint
docs: The BTC quote mint every pot is denominated in. All token accounts are validated against it.

fields.name: quote_decimals
docs: Read from the mint at init (8 for wBTC). Never assumed.

fields.name: lp_draw_max
docs: Max base units per `draw_lp`. ≤ LP_DRAW_MAX_CAP.

fields.name: lp_draw_interval
docs: Seconds between draws. ≥ MIN_LP_DRAW_INTERVAL.

fields.name: creator_fee_bps
docs: Creator fee every registered coin must have been created with (D3, D9). 1..=MAX_CREATOR_FEE_BPS.

fields.name: paused
docs: Global pause: every coin's `settle` refuses.

fields.name: launch_fee_lamports
docs: Lamports `declare_coin` transfers to treasury.

fields.name: satpad_mint
docs: $SATPAD mint, PumpSwap pool and LP mint once bootstrapped; default until then.

fields.name: mint
docs: `Pubkey::default()` for the global flag.

types.name: PayeeChoice
docs: Deployer's choice at launch, written once by `declare_coin`.

types.name: PayeeMode
docs: Who receives the deployer share. `Holders` is permanent (SPEC "Payee modes").

fields.name: paid_out
docs: Paid to the old payee in the same instruction.

types.name: RewardsRun
docs: `["rewards_run", mint, run_index as u64 LE]` (DECISIONS D8). One per holder-rewards release; the snapshot hash is
written here before the pot moves, so anyone can audit who was paid.

types.name: SatpadSet
docs: `set_satpad` (D21): the $SATPAD mint, PumpSwap pool and LP mint were recorded, once.

fields.name: deployer_destination
docs: `PayeePot`, `RewardsPot`, or the treasury ATA for a treasury-only coin.

types.name: Split
docs: Fee split in basis points of the creator fee. Sum is always 10000.
